jobs.title: Asst Project Manager
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities 1. Site Execution Supervision •	Monitor day-to-day civil construction activities at site •	Ensure work is carried out as per drawings, specifications, and quality standards •	Supervise structural and finishing activities as per project stage •	Ensure proper utilization of labour, materials, and equipment 2. Work Planning & Progress Monitoring •	Assist in implementing project schedules and execution plans •	Track daily and weekly progress against planned targets •	Identify delays and suggest corrective actions •	Support senior project leadership in milestone planning 3. Contractor & Subcontractor Management •	Coordinate and supervise contractors at site •	Ensure work quality before certification •	Verify quantities and measurements of executed work •	Maintain discipline, productivity, and adherence to timelines 4. Quality Control •	Ensure construction quality as per standards and approved methods •	Conduct routine inspections and quality checks •	Coordinate with consultants and internal quality teams •	Ensure rectification of non-compliance issues 5. Technical Coordination •	Interpret structural and architectural drawings •	Ensure execution as per latest revisions •	Coordinate with design and consultant teams for clarifications •	Raise technical queries where required 6. Material & Resource Monitoring •	Monitor material usage and minimize wastage •	Coordinate with stores for timely material availability •	Check material quality before use 7. Reporting & Documentation •	Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports •	Maintain site records, measurement sheets, and work logs •	Update management on progress, issues, and risks 8. Safety & Site Discipline •	Ensure compliance with safety norms •	Monitor safe working practices at site •	Report hazards and prevent unsafe activities  Required Skills •	Strong knowledge of civil construction practices •	Good understanding of RCC and finishing works •	Ability to read and interpret technical drawings •	Strong contractor handling and coordination skills •	Good reporting and documentation ability •	Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines  Qualification & Experience •	Diploma / B.Tech in Civil Engineering •	8-15 years of experience in building construction projects
